methods_quotes.q: RRs with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing rates by race and ethnicity (combined), age, and/or sex overall and for each period were calculated.
Rate ratios with 95% CIs excluding 1.0 were considered to be statistically significant.
Statistical analyses were conducted using SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
jurisdictions selected for analyses reported ≥30% of the total number of jurisdictional aggregate cases
Rate ratios are not available in situations where data were suppressed because of <20 cases being reported
